mapper.update:
update access_control_log t
t.b_id = #{newBId},
t.res_param= #{resParam},
t.machine_id= #{machineId},
t.req_param= #{reqParam},
t.state= #{state},
t.community_id= #{communityId},
t.user_name= #{userName},
t.log_action= #{logAction},
t.status_cd= #{statusCd},
t.user_id= #{userId}
where 1=1
and t.log_id= #{logId}
mapper.select: select DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') cTime, count(1) count from access_control_log t where 1=1 and t.community_id = #{communityId} group by date_format(t.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') order by date_format(t.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') desc limit 0,7
